blocks.title: Commercial Engine
blocks.body: Alila commercial distribution rides World of Hyatt direct channels, GDS, OTAs, and parent sales systems. Lifestyle luxury: design-led resorts and urban hideaways with World of Hyatt distribution for travelers seeking place-specific luxury. Owners should underwrite channel mix and loyalty contribution for this asset—not corporate averages alone.

blocks.title: Why Value Is Strongest in These Scenarios
blocks.body:
Keep Local Product Intent—Add World of Hyatt: retain Alila's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Lifestyle luxury: design-led resorts and urban hideaways with World of Hyatt distribution for travelers seeking place-specific luxury.
Sibling Clarity: diligence fit versus same-parent peers before assuming identical owner use case or fee path.
Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
Disclosure Discipline: model economics only from current fee exhibits—Factory 2.0 does not invent undisclosed percentages.
